provenance: Original fixtures drafted for this project. Reference edits are illustrative editorial judgments, not human-review evidence or the only acceptable answers.

cases.original: This document provides an overview of the steps required to start the local server. Run `python serve.py` from the project directory.
cases.reference: To start the local server, run `python serve.py` from the project directory.
cases.rationale: Lead with the task and retain the command and working directory.

cases.original: It is important to note that the cache may contain entries from the previous session. Clear it before comparing results.
cases.reference: The cache may contain entries from the previous session. Clear it before comparing results.
cases.rationale: Remove the announcement while preserving uncertainty and instruction order.

cases.original: The purpose of this release is to fix the export timeout reported on 2026-08-12. Version 2.4.1 raises the limit from 30 seconds to 60 seconds.
cases.reference: Version 2.4.1 fixes the export timeout reported on 2026-08-12 by raising the limit from 30 seconds to 60 seconds.
cases.rationale: Combine related information without losing dates or quantities.

cases.original: Furthermore, the migration is not fully implemented. Existing accounts still require a manual restart.
cases.reference: The migration is not fully implemented. Existing accounts still require a manual restart.
cases.rationale: Keep the negation and remaining work explicit.

cases.original: The app offers a comprehensive and seamless search experience that lets you find saved receipts by merchant or date.
cases.reference: Find saved receipts by merchant or date.
cases.rationale: State the concrete capability without adding a performance claim.

cases.original: The best part? Your notes stay available offline after the first download.
cases.reference: Your notes stay available offline after the first download.
cases.rationale: Remove the staged question and keep the condition.

cases.original: I stayed by the window until the rain stopped. The tea went cold.
cases.reference: I stayed by the window until the rain stopped. The tea went cold.
cases.rationale: The source already has a clear voice; an edit is unnecessary.

cases.original: Perhaps I misunderstood her. I have replayed that conversation all week.
cases.reference: Perhaps I misunderstood her. I have replayed that conversation all week.
cases.rationale: Uncertainty belongs to the narrator and is not filler.

cases.original: The robust estimator limits the influence of outliers. It does not assume normally distributed errors.
cases.reference: The robust estimator limits the influence of outliers. It does not assume normally distributed errors.
cases.rationale: Robust is a technical term; the negative assumption matters.

cases.original: The sample was heated to 80 °C for 15 minutes before weighing.
cases.reference: The sample was heated to 80 °C for 15 minutes before weighing.
cases.rationale: Passive voice appropriately emphasizes the procedure.

cases.original: Generated by Alice Smith. Adapted from [the protocol](https://example.org/protocol-v2).
cases.reference: Generated by Alice Smith. Adapted from [the protocol](https://example.org/protocol-v2).
cases.rationale: Attribution and source links are substantive information.

cases.original: The token grants read access, not write access. It expires after 10 minutes.
cases.reference: The token grants read access, not write access. It expires after 10 minutes.
cases.rationale: The contrast defines a real permission boundary.

cases.original:
1. Open Settings.
2. Choose Export.
3. Select a folder.
4. Choose JSON.
5. Select the date range.
6. Press Save.
cases.reference:
1. Open Settings.
2. Choose Export.
3. Select a folder.
4. Choose JSON.
5. Select the date range.
6. Press Save.
cases.rationale: Six discrete steps justify six list items.

cases.original: The report calls the service "a revolutionary platform". That description is the vendor's, not mine.
cases.reference: The report calls the service "a revolutionary platform". That description is the vendor's, not mine.
cases.rationale: Preserve the quotation and the writer's attribution boundary.

cases.original: It is worth noting that the patch might reduce memory use. The measurements cover only two runs on one device.
cases.reference: The patch might reduce memory use. The measurements cover only two runs on one device.
preserve: only two runs on one device
cases.rationale: Remove prefacing language without strengthening limited evidence.

cases.original: This section describes the way keyboard navigation works. Press Tab to move forward and Shift+Tab to move backward.
cases.reference: Press Tab to move forward and Shift+Tab to move backward.
cases.rationale: Give the operation directly and keep both directions.

cases.original: In order to retry the request, wait until the timer reaches zero. Retrying sooner does not reset the timer.
cases.reference: To retry the request, wait until the timer reaches zero. Retrying sooner does not reset the timer.
cases.rationale: Shorten the introductory phrase without changing behavior.

cases.original: Additionally, version 3.0 drops support for Python 3.8. Python 3.9 and later remain supported.
cases.reference: Version 3.0 drops support for Python 3.8. Python 3.9 and later remain supported.
cases.rationale: Keep the exact compatibility boundary.

cases.original: ✅ Export tests passed. Installation on the physical tablet remains untested.
cases.reference: ✅ Export tests passed. Installation on the physical tablet remains untested.
cases.rationale: The status marker and evidence limitation are useful.

cases.original: Our offering provides users with the ability to export up to 20 reports per month for $4. It does not include shared workspaces.
cases.reference: Export up to 20 reports per month for $4. Shared workspaces are not included.
cases.rationale: Simplify the offer while preserving the limit, price, and exclusion.

cases.original: Photos stay on your device unless you choose Upload. Deleting an upload takes up to 24 hours.
cases.reference: Photos stay on your device unless you choose Upload. Deleting an upload takes up to 24 hours.
cases.rationale: Conditions and delay are central to the promise.

cases.original: Again, I missed the train. Again, I blamed the clock.
cases.reference: Again, I missed the train. Again, I blamed the clock.
cases.rationale: Intentional repetition provides rhythm.

cases.original: At the end of the day, I wanted to go home. I had not slept since Tuesday.
cases.reference: I wanted to go home. I had not slept since Tuesday.
cases.rationale: Remove an empty idiom while preserving the narrator's facts.

cases.original: The results appear to suggest that latency may have decreased. The median was 42 ms before the change and 39 ms after it, across five requests.
cases.reference: Latency may have decreased: the median was 42 ms before the change and 39 ms after it, across five requests.
cases.rationale: Reduce redundant qualification while keeping the core uncertainty and sample size.

cases.original: This is an optimal solution for the stated objective, but it is not unique.
cases.reference: This is an optimal solution for the stated objective, but it is not unique.
cases.rationale: Optimal has a precise technical meaning here.

cases.original: Set `robust = "optimal"` in the fixture. The names deliberately exercise the scanner.
cases.reference: Set `robust = "optimal"` in the fixture. The names deliberately exercise the scanner.
cases.rationale: Source code must survive prose editing exactly.

cases.original: Furthermore, [the appendix](https://example.org/robust?mode=optimal) lists the excluded samples. Exclusions were decided before analysis.
cases.reference: [The appendix](https://example.org/robust?mode=optimal) lists the excluded samples. Exclusions were decided before analysis.
cases.rationale: Edit adjacent prose without rewriting the link destination or analysis order.

cases.original: We collected the samples in three laboratories. Each laboratory used the same protocol.
cases.reference: We collected the samples in three laboratories. Each laboratory used the same protocol.
cases.rationale: Plural authorship can be correct; a personal preference cannot rewrite it.

cases.original: As of 2026-07-03, build 18 had passed emulator checks. No store release was verified.
cases.reference: As of 2026-07-03, build 18 had passed emulator checks. No store release was verified.
cases.rationale: Historical status must not become a current release claim.

cases.original: The result? You can enlarge the text without changing the size of the buttons. This setting applies only to the reader screen.
cases.reference: You can enlarge the text without changing the size of the buttons. This setting applies only to the reader screen.
preserve: without changing the size of the buttons
cases.rationale: Remove the setup question while keeping the scope of the setting.
